releasePlan.notes: Control path (flag off/control variation): Buy Now button hidden, /api/express-checkout returns 404, /express-checkout page unreachable via normal navigation. v1 path (flag on): Buy Now button visible on all product cards, full express checkout flow available. API guard uses stringVariation fail-safe default of 'control'. No prerequisites — express checkout is independent of show-product-reviews.
